title: Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor

Rep. Nick Begich's bill to write the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into law, with a 20-year ban on selling its bitcoin, is now eligible for a House floor vote.

This post Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Switzerland Picks 57 Countries for Crypto Tax Data Sharing Starting in 2028

Switzerland approved 57 partner jurisdictions, including all EU states and the UK, for automatic crypto tax data exchanges under the OECD's CARF from 2028.

This post Switzerland Picks 57 Countries for Crypto Tax Data Sharing Starting in 2028 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

Bithumb Says October Hack Exposed Passports, Bank Accounts and Wallet Addresses

Bithumb said a follow-up review found its October breach exposed more people and data, including passports and wallet addresses, and lasted about 15 days.

DOJ Targets 800 Defendants in Largest-Ever Scam Crackdown, Including Crypto Fraud

The Justice Department said its largest-ever scam crackdown has targeted more than 800 defendants since March, with Southeast Asian crypto scam centers among its top targets.

title: CleanSpark Weighs Selling More Bitcoin Than It Mines After $987M Loss
summary:

CleanSpark Weighs Selling More Bitcoin Than It Mines After $987M Loss

CleanSpark's CFO said the miner may sell more bitcoin than it mines to reduce risk after a $987.1 million fiscal 2026 loss, as its shares hit a new 52-week low.

This post CleanSpark Weighs Selling More Bitcoin Than It Mines After $987M Loss first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
